alt: Paper 2 Exercise 1 has eight short-answer questions for 8 marks on short spoken texts such as a travel announcement (اعلان), a recorded phone message (پیغام) or a brief dialogue (مکالمہ), heard twice and testing L1 and L2.
caption: Eight stated facts from short recordings, each heard twice.

after: ## The kinds of text you will hear
alt: A table of short listening text types with their typical openings and details: an announcement (مسافر توجہ فرمائیں) gives destination, time, gate and changes; a phone message gives caller, reason and new arrangements; a dialogue gives plans; a weather report (آج ... کا امکان ہے) gives places, temperatures and advice.
caption: Knowing the shape tells you where each detail will come.

alt: A table of Urdu question words and the answer form each needs: کب؟ a day or date, کتنے بجے؟ a clock time, کہاں؟ a place, کتنے؟ a number, کون؟ a person, کیا؟ an object or action, کیوں؟ a reason. For where, write پلیٹ فارم نمبر دو, not just دو.
caption: Recognise the question word in the pause and predict the answer.

alt: A table of Urdu numbers that are easy to confuse at speed: سترہ and ستر (17 and 70), اٹھارہ and اسی (18 and 80), اٹھائیس, اڑتیس and اڑتالیس (28, 38, 48), انتیس, انتالیس and انچاس (29, 39, 49), and پچیس, پچاس and پچپن (25, 50, 55), with the sound that tells them apart.
caption: Drill these pairs until they are automatic; write figures in the answer.

alt: A timeline from seven to eight o'clock marking سوا سات بجے (7:15), ساڑھے سات بجے (7:30) and پونے آٹھ بجے (7:45, a quarter to eight, not 8:45), with ڈیڑھ بجے (1:30) and ڈھائی بجے (2:30). Below, جمعرات is Thursday, جمعہ Friday, ہفتہ Saturday or week, and پیر and سوموار both mean Monday.
caption: پونے means a quarter to: پونے آٹھ is 7:45.

alt: In گاڑی دس بجے کے بجائے گیارہ بجے روانہ ہوگی۔ the old time is دس and the new time, the answer, is گیارہ. Signals of a change are کے بجائے, اب, معاف کیجیے / میرا مطلب ہے and پہلے ... تھا، لیکن.
caption: After کے بجائے or لیکن comes the detail that counts now.

after: ## A routine for the two hearings
alt: Four stages: in the pause read the questions and predict answer forms; on the first hearing note key words and figures only; on the second hearing confirm and check changes; afterwards write each short answer clearly and leave no blanks.
caption: Notes on the first hearing, checking on the second, answers after.

alt: Three questions on a flight announcement. The gate is گیٹ نمبر نو, not the old gate سات; the new time is پونے چار بجے (3:45), not 4:45; and passengers are told بورڈنگ کارڈ تیار رکھیں, an instruction.
caption: New detail, exact time with پونے, and the instruction itself.
